ValidationRule.description: Desde el estado Draft, los campos Cliente, Opportunity Name, Need's Description, BBVA Countries Participants, Close Date, Currency tienen que estar rellenos
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND( opportunity_expiration_ind_type__c = false, NOT( $Setup.CIB_Bypass__c.CIB_DES_DataMigration__c ), OR( RecordType.DeveloperName='Business_Opportunity', RecordType.DeveloperName='Draft_Opportunity', RecordType.DeveloperName='Confidential_Opportunity'), OR( ISPICKVAL(StageName,'Proposal'), ISPICKVAL(StageName,'Approval'), ISPICKVAL(StageName,'Ready to close'), ISPICKVAL(StageName,'Closed Won'), ISPICKVAL(StageName,'Closed Lost')), IF( ISBLANK(DES_Prospect__c), OR( ISBLANK(AccountId), ISBLANK(Name), ISBLANK(DES_Description_rich__c), ISBLANK(DES_Countries__c), ISBLANK(CloseDate), ISBLANK(TEXT(CurrencyIsoCode)) ), OR( ISBLANK(Name), ISBLANK(DES_Description_rich__c), ISBLANK(DES_Countries__c), ISBLANK(CloseDate), ISBLANK(TEXT(CurrencyIsoCode))) ) )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: Please check the fields that are not completed: Client name, Opportunity Name, Need's Description, BBVA Countries Participants, Estimated Closing Date and Currency. It is necessary to fill them in order to advance the stage.
